html:
SMTO-GML-0042 — That email conversation has no messages to reply to

GUID: 3c2ff769-67ce-45a6-b3f0-8c9a6c34c348
Slug: gmail-reply-empty-thread
Domain: GML · Subsystem: gml

What happened

  • SMTO tried to reply in a Gmail conversation, but that conversation had no emails in it, for example because they were deleted. No reply was created or sent.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Gmail in your browser and check that the conversation you want to answer still has emails in it and isn't in Trash. If its emails were deleted, there's nothing left to reply to.
  2. In the conversation, ask SMTO to find the specific email, for example 'Find the latest email from alice@example.com in @work_gmail', then ask it to reply to that email. Replying to one specific email gives SMTO a real message to answer.
  3. If the original email is gone, ask SMTO to write a new email instead and say who it should go to. A new email doesn't need an earlier message, only a recipient.

What success looks like

  • SMTO shows a reply draft, or confirms the reply was sent, addressed to the right person.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, along with the subject of the email you meant to answer.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Reply construction (build_reply_mime) received a Gmail thread containing no messages, so no reply target could be selected.

What this means

  • Reply construction receives a thread with no messages. Gmail provider receipts and exact account/message identities determine effects. Authorization, pagination or presentation failure cannot undo a send or other mutation; diagnostic rendering performs no mailbox or OAuth request.

Why this can happen

  • Reply construction receives a thread with no messages.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the exact current thread and account before selecting a reply target.

How to fix it

  • The thread loaded for the reply had no messages (deleted, moved, or a thread_id from another account). Re-search the intended account for a current thread_id or message_id and reply by message_id, or compose a new message with an explicit To recipient.
  • Refresh the thread and choose an existing message, or create a new draft with an explicit recipient.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • An existing intended message is selected or a new message is deliberately composed.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • Gmail provider receipts and exact account/message identities determine effects. Authorization, pagination or presentation failure cannot undo a send or other mutation; diagnostic rendering performs no mailbox or OAuth request.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
